== Biography ==
Unknown was born before 1847. He is the son of [[Glasgow-1623|James Glasgow]] and [[Barkley-2097|Rosanna Barkley]].
== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-1623]] is assessed at 93% (proved). The 1847 family letter explicitly reports James's child by Henry Barkly's servant daughter; James's 1851 marriage to Rosanna, Henry's daughter and a farm servant, closely identifies that father. The child profile represents the unnamed reported child, not a proved later adult.

Selected Glasgow-1623 fatherhood of Glasgow-4023; maternal identity and upstream ancestry are separate.

Next useful test: Seek a baptism or maintenance proceeding naming that child.

Source basis already held: [https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:FGC7-SDN "Ireland Marriages, 1619–1898," database, FamilySearch (record FGC7-SDN (https://www.familysearch.org/ark:/61903/1:1:FGC7-SDN)), marriage of James Glasgow and Rosanna Barkley, 17 March 1851, Portglenone, County Antrim, Ireland; citing p. 153, line 89.]. No new father attached; cited evidence and any inspected register entry are scoped above.
